steps.fScale: The {fScale} has one flat, {bFlat}, instead of {b}. Its right-hand fingering is different: 1 2 3 4 from {f} to {bFlat}, then the thumb passes under to {c} and 1 2 3 4 to the top.
steps.up: The {fScale} going up: finger 4 on the black key, then the thumb under.
steps.down: And going down: 4 3 2 1, then 4 crosses over the thumb to {bFlat}.
steps.leftHand: The left hand keeps its usual fingering: 5 4 3 2 1, 3 crosses over, 2 1.
steps.inTime: Right hand, up and down in time.
